name: dsh-whale-widget
description: DeepSeek balance whale widget for the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI: balance, today's spend and peak/off-peak pricing, a customisable bubble click sequence (text, balance, today, peak/off-peak, image, random lines, and weighted side-by-side picks), per-line styling and fonts, hover quick-edit, sound effects and per-turn cost, custom character, sprites and audio, plus configurable snapping and flipping.
